reasons.why: offer only Circle Gateway options, paid from a Gateway balance that standard x402 clients don't have
reasons.fix: add a plain "exact" option next to Gateway if standard x402 agents should pay too

reasons.why: don't answer 402 at all, so there is nothing to pay
reasons.fix: make the listed route answer 402 (a moved or renamed endpoint stays listed under its old URL until a payment goes through the new one)

reasons.why: name another URL in their 402 than the one requested
reasons.short: name the wrong URL in their 402
reasons.fix: build resource.url from your public origin (behind a TLS proxy: trust proxy, so it stays https)

reasons.why: timed out or could not be reached
reasons.fix: check that the host is up and answers within 10 seconds

reasons.why: ask to be paid in a token that isn't a known USDC contract
reasons.fix: use the network's USDC contract as the asset

reasons.why: offer only testnet payment options
reasons.fix: add a mainnet option (for example Base, eip155:8453) or delist the test endpoint

reasons.why: answered with a server error (5xx): down or failing
reasons.fix: check the server and its hosting (behind Cloudflare, a 52x or 530 means Cloudflare could not reach your origin)

reasons.why: name another host as the MPP realm than the one they're served on
reasons.fix: set realm to the public host name of the endpoint

reasons.why: answer 402 without a valid x402 challenge
reasons.fix: send the PaymentRequired object (base64 JSON in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, mirrored in the body)

reasons.why: charge more than their OpenAPI advertises
reasons.fix: keep the price in openapi.json in step with the 402

reasons.why: price depends on request
charge 10 times what their OpenAPI advertises or more
reasons.fix: check the amount in atomic units, and keep the price in openapi.json in step with the 402

reasons.why: write the amount as dollars ("0.01") instead of atomic units
reasons.short: write dollars instead of atomic units
reasons.fix: use atomic units: "10000" is $0.01 USDC

reasons.why: send an MPP challenge without an expiry
reasons.short: send MPP challenges without an expiry
reasons.fix: set expires on each challenge (a few minutes ahead), so a captured challenge cannot be replayed later

reasons.why: list payment options that would all fail
reasons.fix: fix the blocking problem per option (network name, payTo, amount in atomic units)

reasons.why: pay out to the zero address or another burn address, a placeholder left in the config
reasons.short: pay out to a burn address
reasons.fix: set payTo to the wallet you want to be paid in
